## LibreLinkUp Rust Desktop v0.4.0

### Highlights
- **New: Native Windows 10/11 app**: Same features as the KDE Plasma version.
  - Live dashboard and 12-hour graph
  - System tray icon with a live glucose badge
  - Floating always-on-top overlay
  - Stale-reading detection
  - Urgent-low, repeat and snooze alerts with an alarm sound and Windows notifications
  - Start at sign-in
- **Windows-native security**: Credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, and the key is protected by **Windows DPAPI**, which binds it to your Windows account.
- **Shared core library**: The LibreView client, credential vault, settings, staleness and alert logic are now shared by both apps (`crates/librelinkup-core`). There are no functional changes on Linux.
- **Windows CI**: Every change is built, tested and smoke-tested on Windows with GitHub Actions.

### Windows Installation
Download **`LibreLinkUp-Setup-0.4.0-x64.exe`** and run it.
- **Per-user install:** no administrator prompt is needed.
- **Start-at-sign-in:** an optional setting in the installer.
- **Portable zip:** also available.

> The installer is not code-signed yet. If Windows SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.

### Flatpak Installation (Linux)
```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/russellmilliner/librelinkup-rust-desktop/releases/download/v0.4.0/librelinkup-rust-desktop-v0.4.0-x86_64.flatpak
flatpak install --user -y librelinkup-rust-desktop-v0.4.0-x86_64.flatpak
```
